title.zh: 一场关于 Free-to-Play 游戏设计的演讲
title.en: A speech about Free-to-Play game design

subtitle.en: Comparing games to television to look at how the Free-to-Play business model affects game design.
subtitle.zh: 把游戏比作电视，看 Free-to-Play 这种商业模式如何影响游戏设计。

blocks.en: About a month ago, I gave a speech at Creative Mornings in Portland about the way the Free-to-Play business model affects game design. I compared games to television, looking at the way television business models have drastically affected the composition of those shows.
blocks.zh: 大约一个月前，我在 Portland 的 Creative Mornings 上做了一场演讲，讲 Free-to-Play 这种商业模式如何影响游戏设计。我把游戏和电视做了类比，考察电视的商业模式是怎样剧烈地影响了那些节目的构成。

blocks.en: (I didn't name this speech; the title given here was picked by Creative Mornings after the speech was given.)
blocks.zh: （这场演讲的名字不是我起的；这里给出的标题是 Creative Mornings 在演讲结束之后定的。）
